title: Counter and Pedestal Clock Shop
description: One static clock-shop display and service-counter scene for the original timekeeping shop program. Five complete existing models at original unit scale and identity orientation: a full open-shelf service counter supporting one whole twin-bell alarm clock and a separate whole fixed-open cash-register exterior, beside a complete exhibit plinth supporting the original whole open-frame pendulum clock. Every original part, fixed hand angle, material assignment and raw GLB buffer/internal hierarchy is preserved. The three complete guest soles are contained within the actual unchanged flat top surfaces; all other whole instances are mutually separated, with connected conservative front, middle and peripheral empty strips. Only one floor and cutaway wall boundary are new scene-only geometry. The counter/register customer zone and independent raised clock display form a distinct retail arrangement, not the old floor-level pendulum-plus-sundial display and not additional clocks counted as new models. One scene, zero new independent models. The register remains blank and fixed open; no payment, clock sale procedure, timekeeping, calibration, alarm sound, pendulum motion, mechanism, practical shop operation, compatibility, ergonomic suitability, structural capacity, installation or public safety is claimed.
